description: A PHP trait for wrapping and calling methods on \\PDOStatement objects within Drupal's database abstraction layer, including methods for converting fetch modes, executing statements, and fetching results.

classes.name: PdoTrait
classes.description: A trait providing methods to interact with PDOStatement objects, including fetch mode conversions, execution, and data fetching.

methods.name: fetchAsToPdo
methods.description: Converts a FetchAs mode to a corresponding PDO::FETCH_* constant.

methods.name: pdoToFetchAs
methods.description: Converts a PDO::FETCH_* constant to a FetchAs mode.

methods.name: getClientStatement
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the client-level PDOStatement object.

methods.name: clientSetFetchMode
methods.description: Sets the default fetch mode for the PDO statement based on FetchAs enum.

methods.name: clientExecute
methods.description: Executes the prepared PDO statement with optional arguments.

methods.name: clientFetch
methods.description: Fetches the next row from the PDO statement, formatted according to the specified FetchAs mode.

methods.name: clientFetchColumn
methods.description: Fetches a single column from the next row of the result set.

methods.name: clientFetchObject
methods.description: Fetches the next row as an object of a specified class.

methods.name: clientFetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all rows from the result set, formatted according to the specified FetchAs mode.

methods.name: clientRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last SQL statement.

methods.name: clientQueryString
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string used to prepare the statement.
